games.name: Mini Mart Simulator
games.description: Run your own little supermarket. Order stock on the back office computer, carry the boxes in and fill the shelves and the fridge, set your prices and serve customers at the till: scan their shopping, take card payments and count out the right change. Work in progress: expect changes.
games.controls: WASD move, Shift run, mouse look, E pick up / use, left click place or scan, right click take back, G drop box
updates: New game: first early access version with ordering, shelves, prices, customers and the till

games.name: ZombieCam
games.description: A bodycam-style zombie shooter. Fight off waves of zombies alone or with a squad of up to eight friends, or turn on each other in a private match. You play online with your Pelipaja username: add friends by their username and invite them to your squad. The game is in Finnish. Made by knh19.
games.controls: WASD move, mouse look, left click shoot, right click aim, R reload, 1 / 2 / wheel switch weapon, Shift run, C / Ctrl crouch, Ctrl while running slide, Q / E lean, F weapon light, Tab scoreboard
updates: Ammo boxes and medkits on the ground disappear after a minute. They blink for the last few seconds
New character skins: buy outfits for your officer, from SWAT and hazmat suits to glowing legendary gear. Friends see them in the lobby and in game
14 new weapon skins, the best ones costing up to 150 000 coins, and a goal bar in the shop that shows how close you are to the next one
Redesigned main menu
Darker levels: you really need your weapon light now
Dead zombies disappear after 5 seconds, so big waves no longer slow the game down
Much milder blur when turning

More realistic bodycam: motion blur and rolling shutter when you turn fast, dirty lens that glows around lights, blood on the lens up close, exposure that adapts slowly to the dark and frame drops when you get hit
Camera is mounted on the chest: heel strikes, recoil jolt and leaning into fast turns
Slide: press Ctrl while sprinting
Zombies react harder to hits: heads snap back, leg shots make them stumble, and kills knock bodies back (shotguns up close send them flying)
Sound: zombies behind walls sound muffled, the mic ducks after your own shots, gear rattles when you run and the radio beeps
New game: ZombieCam with online co-op and private matches using your Pelipaja username

games.name: Northline Movers
games.description: Run the vans for Northline Moving, alone or online with a friend. Take jobs from dispatch, carry furniture down the stairs of houses and apartment blocks, wheel the heavy stuff on a hand truck and drive it across town without breaking anything. One of you drives, the other rides along. Work in progress: expect changes.
updates: Voice chat in online co-op: talk to your partner through your microphone. They sound quieter and duller the further away they are, and come from their direction
Your partner's head grows while they talk
Settings: voice chat on or off, open mic or push to talk (hold V), and voice volume
Ultra: the grass is back to the earlier look
New cab interior: live speedometer and rev counter, steering wheel with spokes, centre console, gear lever, mirror, sun visors, door panels and proper seats
Load the same items on top of each other in the van, such as boxes on boxes or sofa on sofa. Light items also stack on flat furniture
Ultra: sharper, higher-resolution textures and furniture models
Ultra: new grass and new stone and sandstone walls on houses
Ultra: car indicators are now glowing lights inside the lamps
Fixed a car model that floated above the road
The indicator key hint no longer covers the driving view
Ultra graphics: realistic asphalt, ground, brick and wooden floors, a photo sky, real trees and new traffic models
All furniture replaced with realistic models: sofa, ottoman, bookshelf, antique bed, vintage TV, laptop, ukulele and more
Choose Ultra or Potato graphics in the settings. The game starts in Potato and switches when Ultra has loaded
Road signs: speed limits, give way and priority road signs
Speed and red light cameras: €300 for driving more than 5 km/h over the limit, €100 for running a red light
Pedestrians walk the sidewalks and cross at the zebra crossings when the lights allow it
Much more traffic: 150 cars and buses
Traffic follows the give-way rules: side streets give way to the ring road and left turns give way to oncoming traffic
Indicators: Q left, E right, X hazard lights. They switch off by themselves after the turn
Other drivers use their indicators before turning
Get out of the van with F
Speed limits: 40 km/h in town, 70 km/h on the ring road
When the van is empty and things are still waiting at the pickup, the route takes you back there
New ring road that winds around the whole town, with every street joining it
Countryside houses along the ring road, a lake and lots of new forest
Almost twice as much traffic, including more city buses
Air brakes: braking builds up smoothly, so normal stops no longer damage the cargo
Buy vehicles and upgrades from the dispatch computer (Vehicles tab)
New large box truck, turbocharger, long top gear and economy kit
Drive modes: Eco, Normal and Sport

games.name: Grow a Fuzzling
games.description: Hatch a fuzzy little creature and raise it from a baby to a grown up. Feed it, wash off the mud, play ball, tuck it into bed and catch berries for coins to buy snacks and hats.
games.controls: Mouse. In berry catch also A / D or the arrow keys.
updates: New game: hatch your own Fuzzling and help it grow up

games.name: Iron Harbor
games.description: A GTA-style harbor city with islands and bridges. Start at your safe house, buy cars, outrun the police and stash your cash in the safe.
updates: Safe house with interior and a safe for your savings
Phone that brings your own car to you
Character customization and cars to buy

games.name: Chained Movers
games.description: Pate and Masa are chained together. Carry the fragile stuff from the mansion to the van before morning, lift the big things together, and don't wake up Ilkka the robot vacuum.
updates: 50 achievements with bronze, silver and gold trophies
Achievements screen with progress and filters, plus in-game notifications
Smoother online play for the joining player

games.name: Chained Climbers
games.description: Pate and Masa are chained together and a storm is rising below. Climb cliffs, icy chimneys and caves inside the mountain. If one falls, the other must hold on. Play solo with Masa the bot or online with a friend.
updates: Peak Pals is now Chained Climbers: two climbers chained together
Climb straight up huge mountains with a storm rising behind you
Caves inside the mountain, icy chimneys, swings across gaps and falling rocks
Singleplayer with Masa the bot, who follows you, holds the chain and shows the way
34 achievements with trophies, progress and filters

games.name: Pizza Moped
games.description: One moped, two riders: one steers and honks, the other works the throttle and keeps the wobbly pizza stack upright. Watch out for speed bumps, cars and hungry seagulls.
updates: New game: two players on one computer or online with a join code
Shared controls and a balancing pizza stack
Seagulls, speed bumps, roadworks and tips

games.name: Cabin Rush
games.description: Midsummer guests are on their way and the summer cabin is a mess. Paint the walls, carry the planks together, heat the sauna and get rid of the wasp nest before the guests pull into the yard.
updates: New game: two players on one computer or online with a join code
Four jobs, a ticking clock and angry wasps

games.name: Cubeland
games.description: An endless block world with caves, villages, diamonds and monsters. Survive the nights, build a portal to the Underworld and find the stronghold that leads to the Rim and its Warden.
updates: New classic pixel-block look: textured grass, dirt, stone, wood, leaves and water
Textured tall grass, flowers and crops, and textured block icons
Caves, diamonds, armor, furnaces, chests and villager trading
The Underworld and the Rim with portals and a final boss
Flowing water and lava, buckets and generative music

games.name: The Goat Mechanic
games.description: A car mechanic simulator. Take jobs from the computer, lift cars onto the hoist and change oil, brake pads and tires.
updates: Oil changes, brake pads and tire swaps
New: money, stock and finished jobs are saved

games.name: Turbo Laps
games.description: A top-down racing game. Win races, beat your lap record in time trial or take the championship in career mode.
updates: Race, time trial and career
New: career progress is saved

games.name: Snake
games.description: Eat apples and grow longer. Don't hit the walls or your own tail.

games.name: Brick Breaker
games.description: Bounce the ball with your paddle and smash every brick. Each level is faster than the last.

games.name: Flapper
games.description: Keep the bird in the air and fly between the pipes. How far can you go?

games.name: Dodge Drop
games.description: Crates rain from the sky faster and faster. Dodge, dash and grab the coins.
Slide the tiles and merge matching numbers. Can you reach the 2048 tile?

games.name: Pong
games.description: The classic for two on one keyboard. First to seven wins.

games.name: Light Cycles
games.description: Light cycles leave a wall behind them. Trap your friend before they trap you.

games.name: Tanks
games.description: Shells bounce off walls once. Five hits wins.

games.name: Air Hockey
games.description: Hit the puck into your friend's goal. Each player stays on their own half.

games.name: Sumo
games.description: Shove your friend out of the ring. The ring shrinks during each round.
